description: Telangana’s AI minister digital twin could reshape citizen engagement, but its governance value will depend on grievance tracking and accountability.
body_lead: Telangana’s AI minister is not a new constitutional office or an autonomous decision-maker. It is a digital twin of IT and Industries Minister D Sridhar Babu, unveiled at Hyderabad DevFest 2026 as a public demonstration of how artificial intelligence could change the way citizens interact with political and administrative leadership. The more important question is therefore not whether an avatar can answer questions on stage, but what happens when such a system moves from a technology showcase to a channel for feedback and grievances.
